scope: Matched-method verification and coarse front integration; front differences are not errors against an independent reference. No continuum, physical-validity or performance claim.
frozen_endpoint_rule: right-sided tangent fixed at the old state, for heating and cooling
energy_normalization: slab volume times [rho*c*(liquidus-solidus)+rho*L]; maximum cumulative defect covers all steps, including unsampled steps

protocol.policy: Day-4 comparison protocol, original synthetic data. The day-1 material, uniform schedules and Stefan reference protocol remain unchanged. These coarse front comparisons are integration experiments, not the day-5 acceptance refinement study.

front_comparison.policy: Use the day-1 Stefan initial temperature, wall, length, area and observation window; compare methods at fixed coarse mesh and width. No front accuracy gate until the independent reference study.

benchmark.parameter_policy: Original synthetic SI parameters fixed on cycle day 1; not a calibrated material or private course dataset. Any later change requires a documented versioned reason.

stefan_plan.status: fixed protocol; solver and reference verification pending
stefan_plan.mode: one-phase melting; initially solid at 310 K; left wall 330 K; insulated far wall
stefan_plan.regularization: solidus=310 K; liquidus=310 K+width; initial liquid fraction zero
stefan_plan.front_definition: linear interpolation of liquid fraction=0.5 at cell centers; undefined crossing reported explicitly
stefan_plan.separation: vary mesh only at dt=0.0625 s and width=0.125 K; vary dt only at N=800 and width=0.125 K; vary width only at N=800 and dt=0.0625 s; check finite-domain effect by doubling length at fixed dx
stefan_plan.acceptance: maximum relative front error <=0.02 over all positive observation times at final settings; investigate failure without selecting favorable times or silently retuning
